Andrea, saw Celigo landed the #1 iPaaS spot in G2's Summer 2025 grid and just shipped Ora and Agent Builder.

Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Andrea, quick follow-up for Celigo.

With Ora and Agent Builder driving new demand, the pressure on pipeline targets usually jumps faster than the team can. Most revenue marketing leaders can't say precisely how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Celigo needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Andrea, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Celigo's motion? I'll tailor it to your team either way.
